description: A subnet calculator that gets /31 and /32 right, which most do not. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

network.description: An IPv4 address with a prefix length ("192.168.1.10/24"), an address and a dotted mask separated by a space ("10.0.0.1 255.0.0.0"), or a bare address, which is read as /24. Octets with leading zeros are refused, as is a mask that is not a run of ones followed by zeros.
